readings.commitment: The 1947 Constitution's signature is Article 9: war renounced as a sovereign right and war potential forsworn — a great power constitutionally disarmed by text
readings.delta: Suppression of the military instrument itself; beneficiary is the postwar pacifist settlement and its neighbors; victim set is autonomous defense capacity; extractiveness of conscription and war finance forbidden at the root

readings.commitment: The 1947 Constitution kept the emperor as symbol: of the state and the people's unity, deriving position from the people's will — sovereignty relocated in a single chapter
readings.delta: Suppression of imperial sovereignty doctrine; beneficiary is popular sovereignty wearing continuity's face; victim set is kokutai theology; extractiveness of rule in the emperor's name ended while the name remained

readings.commitment: The 1947 Constitution was drafted in a week at GHQ: MacArthur's staff wrote it, the Japanese government translated and presented it — origin and ownership contested ever since
readings.delta: Suppression of domestic drafting alternatives (the Matsumoto draft rejected); beneficiary is the occupation's reform program; victim set is autochthonous constitution-making; extractiveness of the founding choice exercised by the occupier

readings.commitment: The 1947 Constitution's rights chapter out-ran its era: individual dignity, sex equality in marriage, academic freedom, social minimums — Weimar's lessons and New Deal hopes written for Japan
readings.delta: Suppression of the household-state's legal hierarchy; beneficiary is individuals against family and state collectives; victim set is the ie system and its codes; extractiveness within family and firm constitutionally answerable

readings.commitment: Article 9 means what it says twice: war renounced, forces never maintained — the Self-Defense Forces are unconstitutional and the text's plain meaning has simply been outvoted by practice
readings.delta: Suppression of all war potential on the text's face; beneficiary is the pacifist reading's integrity; victim set is the SDF's constitutional status; extractiveness of defense spending textually unauthorized

readings.commitment: Article 9 renounces aggression, not existence: the inherent right of self-defense survives any text, and minimum necessary forces for defense are no 'war potential'
readings.delta: Suppression of offensive capacity only; beneficiary is the SDF's legality and the alliance; victim set is literalist pacifism; extractiveness of defense permitted within the minimum-necessary line

readings.commitment: The 2014 reinterpretation crossed the standing line: collective self-defense approved by cabinet decision — the constitution amended in effect by executive reading, never by Article 96
readings.delta: Suppression of the amendment procedure by interpretation; beneficiary is alliance operability and the reinterpreting executive; victim set is the formal amendment path and its supermajorities; extractiveness of constitutional change at cabinet price

readings.commitment: The symbol clause is the revolution: sovereignty moved from emperor to people in one sentence, the deepest change in the document wearing the gentlest words
readings.delta: Suppression of imperial sovereignty at the root; beneficiary is the sovereign people; victim set is rule-in-the-emperor's-name structures; extractiveness of authority re-derived from below

readings.commitment: The symbol emperor was the occupation's keystone bargain: the throne preserved to make the new order governable — revolution rendered acceptable by the oldest face in the room
readings.delta: Suppression of abolitionist and prosecutorial outcomes; beneficiary is transition stability and the throne; victim set is accountability for the war conducted in that name; extractiveness of legitimacy transferred at amnesty's price

readings.commitment: The clause killed kokutai as law: the mystical national polity demoted to ceremony — what survived is a state office performing continuity, not a divine descent ruling through it
readings.delta: Suppression of theological statehood; beneficiary is secular constitutionalism; victim set is kokutai orthodoxy and its enforcement apparatus; extractiveness of belief decoupled from civic standing

readings.commitment: The constitution is an occupation document: drafted by foreigners in English in six days and enacted under duress — autonomy requires revision, says this reading, whatever the content's merits
readings.delta: Suppression of national authorship at the founding; beneficiary is revisionist constitutional politics; victim set is the text's claim to indigenous legitimacy; extractiveness of the founding choice made under occupation

readings.commitment: Whatever its drafting, the people made it theirs: seven decades unamended by choice, defended at every revision attempt — adoption by sustained refusal to change a comma
readings.delta: Suppression of the imposition argument by acceptance over time; beneficiary is the text's living legitimacy; victim set is origin-essentialism; extractiveness of the founding cured by the longest unamended run in the world

readings.commitment: The drafting was a negotiation, not a dictation: Japanese liberal drafts fed GHQ's text, the Diet amended it substantively, and Article 25's social rights are a Japanese insertion
readings.delta: Suppression of the pure-imposition narrative by the record; beneficiary is co-authorship history; victim set is both purity stories; extractiveness of the founding shared unevenly but genuinely

readings.commitment: Article 13 is the catalog's root: all people respected as individuals, the right to pursue happiness — the clause from which privacy and personal autonomy doctrine grew
readings.delta: Suppression of collectivist subordination of the person; beneficiary is unenumerated-rights claimants; victim set is family-state legal logic; extractiveness of the individual by the group made reviewable

readings.commitment: Article 24 reconstitutes the family: marriage by mutual consent only, with equal rights of the sexes — the household code's hierarchy abolished at constitutional rank
readings.delta: Suppression of the ie household's legal authority; beneficiary is wives and children as equal legal persons; victim set is patriarchal headship; extractiveness within marriage constitutionally leveled

readings.commitment: Article 25 promises the minimum: wholesome and cultured living as a right, with the state obligated to social welfare — justiciability thin, direction unmistakable
readings.delta: Suppression of destitution as constitutional indifference; beneficiary is welfare claimants and the programs built to the clause; victim set is minimal-state readings; extractiveness of poverty made the state's named business
